description: Prepare a withdrawal of collateral tokens from a Morpho Blue market position. Returns a ready-to-sign transactions array. Supports "max" for full collateral withdrawal. Includes health factor check when user has active borrows. A BlueBundlesV1 authorization transaction may come first in transactions.

amount.description: Collateral token amount in human-readable decimals (e.g., "1.5"), or "max" for full withdrawal

name: morpho_prepare_withdraw_collateral
